title: Platypus Ki Ye Superpower Aapko Hila Degi! ⚡ #shorts
idea: Platypus hunts underwater with eyes and ears closed using 40,000 electric sensors on its bill.

lines.text: Ye anokha jaanwar paani ke andar bina dekhe shikaar karta hai!
Underwater jaate hi yeh apni aankhein, kaan aur naak band kar leta hai.
Lekin iski chonch par poore 40,000 electric sensors hote hain!
Yeh shikaar ki muscles ka sabse chota electric current bhi pakad leta hai.
Isi superpower se yeh andhere paani mein bhi sateek shikaar karta hai!
Kya aapne pehle kabhi kisi aise mammal ke baare mein suna tha?
